title: JetBrains IDE settings
whyItMatters: JetBrains IDEs keep per-project settings, recent project names and plugin state here. Saved passwords are not in this folder, but the project history still shows what the person worked on.
source: JetBrains, Directories used by the IDE: configuration is stored in ~/.config/JetBrains/<product><version> - https://www.jetbrains.com/help/idea/directories-used-by-the-ide-to-store-settings-caches-plugins-and-logs.html
notes: Database and VCS passwords are kept in the OS keyring, not in this folder; the credentials.keyrings rule covers that store. Plugins and local caches live under ~/.local/share/JetBrains instead.

cleanup.exportFirst: Use File > Export Settings in each JetBrains IDE to save the settings you want to keep.
cleanup.signOut: Sign out of JetBrains Account in the IDE, and remove this machine from the account's authorized devices on the JetBrains website.
steps: Sign out of the JetBrains Account in each IDE.
Uninstall the IDEs with your package manager or the Toolbox app.
Delete the folder named in the plan using the file manager.
cleanup.risk: Removes per-project settings, recent project names and plugin state for every JetBrains IDE on this machine. Project files themselves are not touched.
cleanup.source: JetBrains, Directories used by the IDE to store settings, caches, plugins and logs: https://www.jetbrains.com/help/idea/directories-used-by-the-ide-to-store-settings-caches-plugins-and-logs.html
